summary: Halo is a self-hosted website building and content management tool written in Java. It allows you to construct and manage public-facing web pages and documentation directly from your own server infrastructure.
goodFor: Teams or individuals looking for a Java-centric content management platform who can navigate documentation primarily written in Chinese.
watchOut: The primary documentation and community resources are predominantly in Chinese, which may present a barrier to troubleshooting for non-fluent speakers.
deployNotes: As a Java application deployed via Docker, it typically requires persistent volume mounts for stored data and a separate reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
